name: Cat Selfie Maker
author: hearth-team
description: Generate a 9:16 vertical iPhone-style selfie of a cat — deliberately ordinary, with awkward framing or candid imperfection. Uses OpenAI gpt-image-1. The default prompt is editable from Configure Skill (override) and falls back when cleared.
prompt_template: A vertical 9:16 ordinary iPhone snapshot of a cat taking a selfie in a casual setting, with some accessory/prop, an awkward or mundane candid expression, and an imperfection like blur, bad framing, clutter, or harsh lighting. Avoid cinematic, polished, professional, or glamour-style composition.

vault_inputs.label: Prompt template
vault_inputs.placeholder: Leave blank to use the default cat-selfie prompt baked into this skill.
vault_inputs.help: Override the default image-generation prompt. Clear the box to fall back to the skill's bundled default. Stored encrypted in your local vault.
